title: Pa. Guard relocate during Tropical Storm Florence
description: Pennsylvania National Guard relocate some of their aviation assets to McEntire Joint National Guard Base from Joint Base Charleston, South Carolina, Sept. 16, 2018. While in transit, crews flew through remnants of Tropical Storm Florence and monitored flood prone areas for potential needs and support. (U.S. Air National Guard Video by Master Sgt. George Roach)
